name: Financing Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the coded reason for the financing status.

CA01.name: Cancellation Request Out Of Time
CA01.definition: Cancellation request message was received after the end of the financing process previously activated.

CA02.name: No Matching Financing Request
CA02.definition: Cancellation request does not match with an invoice financing request received previously.

AC01.name: Incorrect Account Number
AC01.definition: Format of the account number specified is not correct.

AC04.name: Closed Account Number
AC04.definition: Account number specified has been closed on the Receiver's books.

AC06.name: Blocked Account
AC06.definition: Account specified is blocked, prohibiting posting of transactions against it.

BE08.name: Unrecognised Financing Requestor
BE08.definition: Party who sent the request message is not recognised by the first agent.

BE09.name: Unrecognised Intermediary Agent
BE09.definition: Party who forwarded the request message is not recognised by the first agent.

BE10.name: Unexpected Intermediary Agent
BE10.definition: Financing Requestor is expected to send requests through a different Intermediary Agent.

BE11.name: Unrecognised Party
BE11.definition: Party is not recognised by the first agent.

DT02.name: Invalid Payment Due Date
DT02.definition: PaymentDueDate is occurring before the request message creation date.

ID01.name: Duplicated Request Message
ID01.definition: Request message received appears to have been duplicated.

ID02.name: Wrong Identification
ID02.definition: Request message received appears to have a wrong identification.

MI01.name: Missing Mandatory Information
MI01.definition: Information bilateral agreed as mandatory is missing.

NA01.name: Narrative
NA01.definition: Reason is provided as narrative information in the additional reason information.

CA03.name: Financing Process Already Initiated
CA03.definition: Cancellation request was correctly received but the financing process has already been initiated.
